new_statements.rule_in_words: Primary stress is predictable and falls on the penultimate syllable of the word; most words are disyllabic, monosyllables and longer words also occur (no statement about how they behave beyond the penult rule).
new_statements.secondary_stress: Nothing said in the recovered snippets.
new_statements.exceptions: None in the recovered snippets; the section's 'dialect differences' concern the /l/ ~ /r/ split (Gamsungi /r/), not stress.
new_statements.domain_note: Word-level ('penultimate syllable of words'), from a short field sketch (LIPI ethnolinguistic project 2010-2013, four villages Gamkonora/Talaga/Tahafo/Gamsungi); 'appears to' marks it as a preliminary observation. Note this differs from the antepenultimate default reported for the closely related Sahu (Visser & Voorhoeve 1987 via StressTyp2/WALS) and Waioli (Fortgens 1905).
new_statements.identity_note: The statement is about Gamkonora proper (gamk1238), described by Bowden from the four Gamkonora villages (Gamkonora, Talaga, Tahafo, Gamsungi) in Ibu Selatan, Halmahera Barat; Voorhoeve 1988 and Severn 1995 classify it as a dialect of Sahu (sahu1245), and the Indonesian Peta Bahasa files it as a Ternate dialect, but Kleden & Imelda 2011 and Duwila et al. 2026 treat it as a separate language. The Sahu stress codings (antepenultimate, StressTyp2/WALS via Visser & Voorhoeve 1987) refer to the Pa'disua dialect, not Gamkonora.

tone.quote: Secara umum, bunyi vokal yang terdapat dalam bahasa Gamkonora ada 5 jenis, yaitu /a/, Jil, ful, fel dan /o/, Akan tetapi, satu catatan, yaitubunyi vokal /o/ ditemukan pada beberapa kata serapan dari bahasa Indonesia, seperti belajar.
tone.locator: Panduan Ortografi, 'Bunyi Vokal', p. 1; consonant table p. 2; no tone/stress passage anywhere in pp. 1-4 or in the sampled entries
tone.translation: In general there are 5 vowel sounds in Gamkonora, namely /a/, /i/, /u/, /e/ and /o/. One note, however: the vowel /o/ [schwa-like value in the chart] is found in some loanwords from Indonesian, such as belajar.
